name: ▶ Current experiment
description: Live view of what Claude is testing right now. NOW: worm rings and gliders living together. fuseWorms with F = 0.048, k = 0.0639, wave_to_k = 0.004, wave_to_F = 0.018: the glider's own wave lifts F around it and keeps it moving, while the still rings don't grow. Each ring is a clean eater: gliders hitting within ~20 px of centre are absorbed and the ring is unharmed; wider ones pass by. Tint = wave reagent d.
